full_judgment:
10. There is no dispute that the detaining authority can pass an order of detention, but it cannot remain valid for more than 30 days if its life is not extended by the Government while it is alive. Now the question that arises before us is; whether the date of limitation of 30 days should be computed from the date of passing of the detention order or from the date of service of the order upon the detenu. 

 11. The words "after making thereof" appearing in sub-section (3) of See Lion 3 of the Act clearly answer the question before us. Those words mean that the period of limitation of 30 days will begin to run from the date of making of the order. So, we do not find any substance in the contention of the respondents.
